question: Which of the following states organises 'Lokrang', a five-day festival, beginning every year on 26 January?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Lokrang'** is a prominent cultural festival held annually in **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• The festival **begins** every year on **26th January.**
 
• This event has a **duration of five days.**
 
• 'Lokrang' showcases the rich traditional** folk dances and music** of the region.
 
• The festival exhibits a wide range of** cultural performances, including tribal dances, classical dances, dramas, and folk theaters.**
 
• It is an event that reflects the **vast cultural diversity of Madhya Pradesh** and offers an engaging cultural experience for visitors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Festivals of Other States:**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh:**

 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is known for its rich tribal culture with **26 major tribes** and numerous sub-tribes.
 
• The **Solung festival**, celebrated by the Adi tribe, is one of the most prominent in the state.
 
• The state is also known for traditional crafts like** weaving, wood carving, and pottery.**
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh:**
 
 
• Himachal Pradesh hosts a variety of local festivals such as **Kullu Dussehra and Lavi Fair.**
 
• It's also renowned for its rich tradition in **folk dance and music**, such as the popular **Nati dance.**
 
• The **'Rampur Jatar' **is a well-known fair that displays traditional **folk art and craft.**
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is known for its diverse culture and traditions.
 
• Festivals like** Diwali, Holi, and Eid **are celebrated with great fervour.
 
• **Kumbh Mela**, a large-scale Hindu pilgrim festival, is held in the city of Prayagraj (formerly Allahabad), attracting millions of devotees.
 
• Uttar Pradesh also has a rich tradition of classical **music and dance**, including **Kathak,** one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
